title: Vampire: Bat Form and Wolf Form
changes: New Night skill Bat Form (Lv 12, after Bat Swarm): become a great black bat for 6s, much faster, harder to hit and never slowed. You can still use Night skills.
New Fang skill Wolf Form (Lv 14, after Night Pounce): howl and become a huge black wolf for 10s that bites harder and faster and makes foes bleed. You can still use Fang skills.
Any skill from another school, or the form again, gives you your own shape back. The change plays as a smooth shift of the body.
The vampire skill tree is a little wider to fit the two new skills.
